publication_guardrails: A source ID must resolve through the core source registry or a registered source extension.
Do not upgrade a claim because several files mention it; preserve the verification/authority status of the directly supporting source.
Use a specific practice guide/guidance source where available rather than a broad umbrella organisation record.
Do not infer national teaching frequency from curriculum, textbook or programme guidance.
Do not substitute legacy PEP evidence for revised-series evidence.
Candidate or not-publicly-recovered artifact metadata must preserve its explicit status.
